question.text: Operating expenses in PMS (excluding brokerage) are capped at:

answer.text: 0.50% per annum of the client's average daily AUM, excluding brokerage

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI norms cap operating expenses (excluding brokerage) charged to a PMS client at 0.50% per annum of the client's average daily assets under management, which is the regulatory ceiling on this fee head. The Trap: 2% and 5% figures conflate operating expenses with broader management or aggregate fee notions, and "1% of profits" mischaracterises an expense cap as a performance-based fee. Note: Disclose management, performance and operating expenses as distinct fee heads in client reporting so that the 0.50% operating-expense cap is verifiable line-by-line.
